page: Microsoft Azure E96ds_v6 is an Edsv6-family memory-optimized server instance configured with 96 vCPUs and 768.0 GB of RAM, yielding an 8.0 GB memory-to-core ratio. Powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8573C x86_64 processor running at 4.2 GHz, this virtual machine features 48 physical cores with Hyper-Threading enabled and a 260 MB L3 cache. The hardware configuration includes 5669 GB of local storage and supports Premium Storage.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier performance in memory bandwidth, with uncached large-block read speeds reaching 506.7 GB/sec and write speeds at 207.77 GB/sec. The processor's advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions, contribute to top-tier results in Passmark CPU tests and strong multi-core stress-ng performance. Database operations and Redis SET operations both rank in the top tier, with Redis achieving 122.52 million operations per second.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high density of memory relative to compute cores reduces the need to over-provision vCPUs solely to acquire sufficient RAM. This resource balance makes the instance highly efficient for memory-intensive workloads. The server is optimized for large-scale database systems, in-memory caching layers, high-throughput web serving, and medium-scale LLM inference tasks.
